newsitem.title: INDIA: India allows 100,000 bales cotton exports.
newsitem.headline: India allows 100,000 bales cotton exports.

text.p: The Indian government allowed the Maharashtra State Cooperative Cotton Growers Marketing Federation Ltd to export an additional 100,000 bales of cotton, the Textiles Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that the additional quota was meant for immediate export.
It said that 320,000 bales of cotton had previously been released for export by the federation in the 1995/96 (September-August) cotton season.
